description: This file defines multiple UI component functions such as Button, Card, Progress, Badge, and Modal. These components create DOM elements dynamically in JavaScript for use in a web application, and are meant to be used as a library of UI building blocks.

methods.name: Button({ label, onClick, variant = 'primary', type = 'button', attrs = {} })
methods.description: Creates a button element with specified label, click handler, variant styles, and attributes.

methods.name: Card({ title, body })
methods.description: Builds a section element styled as a card, with optional title and body content.

methods.name: Progress({ value = 0 })
methods.description: Constructs a progress bar element that visually represents a value between 0 and 1.

methods.name: Badge({ text })
methods.description: Creates a span element styled as a badge with specified text.

methods.name: Modal({ title, content, actions = [] })
methods.description: Generates a modal dialog with a backdrop, title, content, and action buttons, with close behavior.

ctags.name: Button
ctags.pattern: /^export function Button({ label, onClick, variant = 'primary', type = 'button', attrs = {} }) {$/
